name: notifier
summary: Sends a message to Telegram, Discord, Slack or a signed webhook when an app starts, stops, restarts, crashes, loops, goes over its memory limit or fails a health check. Adds the notify command.
head: Asks for permission to
perms: Read app status and lifecycle events (read access only)
Make outbound network connections; the manifest names api.telegram.org, discord.com and hooks.slack.com
Write only to its own state directory
Receive OXIDEPM_TELEGRAM_TOKEN from the daemon's environment

name: exporter-prometheus
summary: Serves /metrics in the Prometheus text format on 127.0.0.1:9616. On each scrape it asks the daemon for the status of the apps, and answers 503 with oxidepm_up 0 when it cannot.
head: Asks for permission to
perms: Read app status (read access only)
Make outbound network connections (no hosts named)
Read its own state directory, write nothing

name: ui-web
summary: Serves a REST API and a WebSocket on 127.0.0.1:9615 by default. Shows apps and can stop and restart opted-in apps. API requests require an access key except for /api/health. Adds the web command.
head: Asks for permission to
perms: Control the apps that list it (lifecycle access, opted-in apps only)
Receive lifecycle events
Make outbound network connections (no hosts named)
Read and write only its own state directory

name: ui-tui
summary: The terminal dashboard: the apps with state, CPU and memory, the selected app in detail and its log. Stopping or restarting an app asks for y or n first. Runs only while the dashboard is open. Adds the monit command.
head: Asks for permission to
perms: Stop and restart apps (lifecycle access, all apps)
No network connections
No file access of its own

name: runtime-node
summary: Runs Node.js apps: the node, npm, pnpm and yarn runtimes. It tells the daemon what to run and the daemon runs it.
head: Asks for permission to
perms: Read app status (read access only)
No network connections
Read only its own state directory, write nothing
Start no programs of its own: it tells the daemon what to run

name: runtime-python
summary: Runs Python apps, in the project's virtualenv when it has one. Provides the python runtime.
head: Asks for permission to
perms: Read app status (read access only)
No network connections
Read only its own state directory, write nothing
Start no programs of its own: it tells the daemon what to run

name: runtime-go
summary: Runs Go apps with go run. Provides the go runtime.
head: Asks for permission to
perms: Read app status (read access only)
No network connections
Read only its own state directory, write nothing
Start no programs of its own: it tells the daemon what to run

name: runtime-rust
summary: Builds and runs Rust apps: a single file with rustc, a project with cargo. Provides the rust and cargo runtimes.
head: Asks for permission to
perms: Read app status (read access only)
No network connections
Read only its own state directory, write nothing
Start no programs of its own: it tells the daemon what to run

name: check
summary: Check project readiness with oxidepm check. Use start --check to opt in to preflight for a single target.
head: Permissions
perms: Read files and app status
Write within the current working directory and its own state directory
Make outbound network connections and start programs

name: init
summary: Scan a project and generate oxidepm.config.toml with oxidepm init.
head: Permissions
perms: Read app status
Read and write within the current working directory and its own state directory
Require enforcement of its network block
Start no programs

name: git-start
summary: Clone or update a Git checkout and start it with oxidepm git-start.
head: Permissions
perms: Read files and app status
Write only inside its own state directory
Make outbound network connections and start programs
Receive HOME and SSH_AUTH_SOCK from the daemon environment

name: deploy
summary: Pull code and restart services with oxidepm deploy. Inspect the remote checkout with oxidepm diff.
head: Permissions
perms: Read files and app status
Make outbound network connections and start ssh
Receive HOME and SSH_AUTH_SOCK and request access to the SSH agent socket
Write no local files

name: watch
summary: Restart opted-in apps when files change under the paths set in apps.adapters.watch.
head: Permissions
perms: Control opted-in apps and receive lifecycle events
Read files without writing
Require enforcement of its network block
Start no programs

name: AI adapters
summary: AI adapters are unavailable in this release.
head: Permissions
perms: To be announced
